jobs.occupation: Team Lead Group Reporting & General Ledger (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Steuern und Prüfungswesen)
jobs.description: About UsWhat if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.About the roleAs Team Lead Group Reporting & General Ledger, reporting to the Head of Accounting, you’ll lead the team that owns Forto’s general ledger, IFRS consolidated financial statements, and HGB statutory accounts. You’ll partner closely with FP&A, Corporate Finance & Investor Relations, Tax, Treasury, and our external auditors to deliver accurate, timely, and compliant reporting across the group.Key Responsibilities- Lead, coach, and develop the team, fostering a culture of accuracy, ownership, and continuous improvement.- Ensure general ledger integrity across all entities, including the chart of accounts, journal entry review, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.- Own Forto’s group close (monthly, quarterly, and year-end) and consolidation, including intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and FX translation.- Prepare the monthly IFRS consolidated financial statements and notes, and the annual HGB single-entity financial statements for the German entities and management reports.- Lead the annual audits (local and Group) as the main point of contact for our external auditors.- Assess complex and non-routine transactions (e.g., IFRS 16 leases, IFRS 15 revenue and cost recognition, IFRS 9 financial instruments, IFRS 2 share-based payments) and prepare technical accounting memos.- Lead the IFRS 18 implementation, effective from 1 January 2027.- Maintain group accounting policies and the reporting manual.Required Skills and Experience- 8+ years experience in group reporting, general ledger accounting, consolidation, or audit, including 2+ years leading a team of accounting professionals.- A degree in Accounting or Finance, and a professional accounting qualification (e.g., or Wirtschaftsprüfer/Bilanzbuchhalter, CPA, ACCA, CA).- In-depth IFRS and solid HGB knowledge, with the ability to turn standards into practical guidance.- Experience running a multi-entity close, preparing consolidated financial statements, and managing external audits.- Experience with ERP and consolidation systems (e.g., LucaNet, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central) and advanced Excel skills.- A structured, detail-oriented, hands-on approach and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, scaling environment.- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting topics to non-finance audiences.- Ability to manage several stakeholders at the same time, especially during closing processes- Actively and continuously searching for improvements of our financial processes- Fluent written and verbal English and German.Preferred Skills and Experience- Experience in logistics or a fast-paced tech company.- Experience using automation or AI to improve finance processes.- Experience in modeling financial solutions (e.g. in regard to the valuation of options, ECL-assessments).Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! Why work with us?Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Buchführung, Buchhaltung, Kundenberatung, -betreuung, Berichtswesen, Information

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager AWS Cloud & AI Strategy (w/m/d) (Unternehmensberater/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Manager AWS Cloud & AI Strategy (f/m/d) to join our** Consulting (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/consulting-solutions) **division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You translate executive business priorities into cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI transformation roadmaps and help clients define their future business and operating models.Transformation – You develop business cases, target operating models and transformation blueprints, while driving process redesign and operating model transformation enabled by Agentic AI.Growth – You collaborate with technical teams to define integrated end-to-end cloud and AI solutions and drive strategic AWS pursuits.Leadership – You shape compelling AWS and AI transformation narratives for C-level stakeholders, influence strategic decision-making, build trusted executive relationships and drive business-led transformation from strategy to execution.Your profile- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Technology Management, Computer Science, or a comparable field.- You bring 6-10 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, business transformation, and/or technology strategy, including the development of business cases, operating models and executive-level programs.- You possess deep AWS expertise combined with strong executive advisory capabilities and can translate complex business requirements across cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI into scalable solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.- You have a proven track record of acting as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, driving strategic initiatives from initial concept through implementation and orchestrating collaboration across business and technology teams.- You communicate confidently in English and German, combine a collaborative and hands-on approach with a strong enthusiasm for GenAI and emerging technologies to turn innovative ideas into tangible client value.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Family – Working parents bring huge value to our firm and we want to ensure that they are supported at every stage and feel confident balancing their work and home lives. Also, we support you, If required, in caring for relatives by arranging carers, special leave or part-time models.Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime in your flex-time account and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. A partial payout is possible once a year. We will be happy to discuss the exact details with you in a personal meeting. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups andAnd there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our Experience Consulting team, you will accompany our clients on the way to a new or improved digital product with designs, concepts and qualitative user research. We combine design thinking methods with collaborative workshop formats to involve as many stakeholders as possible from brainstorming to go-live. Help us to leverage the growth potential of our clients in the digital world!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Felix Baumecker at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) to join our Internal Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche) division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You will support strategy and acquisition / carve-out projects for PwC across EMEA. In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionJoin our Medicinal Chemistry Department and help us explore the full potential of NMR in drug discovery.As an NMR Specialist, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, providing structural insights into protein-ligand complexes and supporting projects with NMR-based screening data. Using our state-of-the-art facilities, you will have the opportunity to develop and apply innovative NMR approaches and contribute directly to advancing our drug discovery projects.We are looking for someone who combines scientific curiosity with agility, accountability and an entrepreneurial mindset, and who enjoys working collaboratively to turn new ideas into meaningful scientific impact.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is limited for 2 years.Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.Tasks & responsibilities- One of your key tasks will be to explore and implement NMR experiments and technologies to develop an infrastructure capable of fast and robust NMR protein and protein ligand co-structure determination by combining traditional strategies with modern AI tools- Moreover, you will apply state-of-the-art NMR experiments to enable integral membrane proteins to characterize binding events, conformational changes and dynamics- In addition, you will increase speed of resonance assignment by automation of processes and software packages such as NMRtist- Furthermore, you will conduct protein- and ligand-detected Fragment Based screening by NMR, optimize automated analysis workflows and provide validated hits to project teams- You will also provide hands-on support in maintaining NMR and lab equipment infrastructure- You will have the opportunity to work together with protein scientists to express and purify isotopically labeled proteinsRequirements- You have a Ph.D. degree in Biochemistry, Structural Biology, or Biophysics or a related area with a strong background in Protein NMR spectroscopy- You have a thorough understanding of NMR structure determination and are keen to study and compare a variety of NMR methods and build an optimized infrastructure- You have proven your skills in publications and presentations- You are experienced in cloning and expressing labeled protein targets including selective labeling- You can work independently, plan, organize, troubleshoot, present work and show innovative thinking in multidisciplinary teams- You are well organized, and have strong interpersonal and communication skills- English (fluent verbal and written) and German are our working languagesAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process.
